ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   D. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   D. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   B. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   B. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Surah Naas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in His and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings able to: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Manners of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
